title: The PCP-for-PPAD conjecture: a quasilinear reduction
coverage: The paper is about 10.8k lines of LaTeX in build/sections/. I read and checked the following. (1) Sec 1: the definitions, the main theorem and the normalization footnote. (2) Sec 6 (outer composition), in full. This covered the port-gadget interface (Thm 6.1), the flag, validation and average-correction lemmas, the expander-walk sampling, tape rationalization with total variation eta0/S0, cohort round-robin, the routing load O(T_tap G0)=O(R), the direct-cone error constants (C_ar=18J_d+108), and the charge lemma (i)-(v). It also covered the parameter order (q0, then grids, omega, eta0, d_sync, beta, eps, delta) and the arithmetic of coarse synchronization (factor 2 from the 4m/m normalization; 6*sqrt(C_tot*delta) from failed cones with range 3). I re-derived the fine-residual bound (it is below beta*c_*kappa/2 under (6.q0) and (6.fine-budget)), the clip-mean lemma, the endpoint rounding bound 4(10tau)^2, the quasilinear size count and the totality lemma (mesh denominator ceil(20/eps); every arithmetic, Less and Boolean case checked). (3) Sec 9 (inner gadget): source correspondence, validation at the true tuple, the read-load bounds (ig:external-load and ig:internal-load), the explicit subcircuit, the error constants, the parameter choices, coarse and fine synchronization, and the designated-output loss accounting. (4) Sec 10: the geometry theorem statement, segment separation, the field definition Phi with the mean-interface prescription, and the full proof that displacement survives clipping (tube case, inside default region, mu>=1/2 cases). I also checked the Margulis-Gabber-Galil half-lazy gap: (1+5*sqrt(2)/8)/2 is about 0.942, below 0.99, so kappa=1/100 holds. NOT audited in depth: Secs 2-5 (macrograph, outer codes and programs, finite-difference representation with its bounded recursion depth, the Fourier-orbit scheduling), Secs 7-8 (inner algebra, binary point/line/product tables and the average correction theorem), Sec 11 (game and market consequences) and the appendix. These sections supply the interfaces that Secs 6 and 9 take as black boxes (Thm outer-representation, Lemma inner-binary-interface, Prop dummy-port), so they are where any remaining gap would most likely be.
main_claim: The paper states fixed constants eps<1/10 and delta>0 and a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from End-of-Line (length N) to a generalized circuit of total encoding length A*N*ceil(log2(N+2))^b. Any rational assignment that eps-satisfies all but a delta fraction of the gates is claimed to decode in polynomial time to an End-of-Line solution, and such assignments of polynomial length are claimed always to exist. This would resolve the quasilinear PCP-for-PPAD conjecture of Babichenko-Papadimitriou-Rubinstein.
